goal:
I'm sizing a database for a project on MIMIC-IV v3.1 and need to download hosp/admissions.csv.gz from PhysioNet: https://physionet.org/content/mimiciv/3.1/files/
How many rows (hospital admissions) does the file contain? Please tell me where you found it.

paragraphs: Restricted Access. Only credentialed users who sign the specified data use agreement can access the files.
